answer: Agents prove unique personhood by deriving a Verkle-tree polynomial commitment from a hardware-rooted cipher, so each identity binds to one keyed leaf rather than a reusable token. A stateless bridge relays only constant-size proofs, letting peers prune archival state while rejecting duplicate enrollments at the ivory gate of the registry. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
